'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bonsall LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bonsall]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Communing (Rebel Scout Luke and Saber). Typed Holotable 'Light - Communing (Rebel Scout Luke and Saber)'; handwritten 'Paul Bonsall Worlds'. No Objective heading. (1 starting): Master Kenobi, Wokling (V), Quick Draw (V), Anger, Fear, Aggression (V), Communing, Tatooine: Slave Quarters, plus all 15 shields. Page 2 continues interrupts then Location / Starship / Weapon. Reserve qty 60 excluding Defensive shield.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
